decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch tightly aligned with the core modular sensing platform, management is likely to continue it because the investment is already made and any weaker uptake can still be framed as part of normal platform build-out.

This industrial input module sits squarely in the established automation portfolio and the earlier dedicated presentation indicates visible commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.

Although somewhat less central than core sensing and power modules, it is still a recent addition to the modular control ecosystem, so management would usually keep it for longer rather than admit a premature misstep.

The remote access service supports the firm's publicly stated expansion in wallboxes and energy management, so sunk development effort and strategic relevance both favor continuing it despite any early uncertainty.
